question: How many new suspected measles cases will Bangladesh's DGHS report for the 24 hours to 8:00 am on 13 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: DGHS weekday bulletins in Oct–early Nov 2026. Average daily counts from cumulative totals rose from ~1,170 (14–18 Oct) to ~1,200 (18–30 Oct) to ~1,280 (30 Oct–2 Nov). Latest weekday counts were 1,232–1,492. Saturday bulletins, which cover the Friday weekend, run low (987 on 31 Oct). The 13 Nov 2026 bulletin falls on a Friday and covers Thursday, a working day; earlier Friday bulletins were normal (1,164 on 16 Oct, 1,316 on 30 Oct). Median about 1,295, with a slight upward drift offset by the possibility that the vaccination campaign starts to bring cases down. No human market was found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
